title: Decadent Dollhouses
content: Carrie Becker is a photographer and a sculptor of miniatures who produces exquisitely detailed interior scenes.In "Barbie Trashes Her Dreamhouse," she presents rooms of a hoarder's home stuffed to the gills with clutter.After completing a masters program in sculpture, Becker traveled through rural Kansas, exploring andphotographing the interiorsof abandoned houses.She used this inspiration as she outfitted each tiny room, implying the backstory to her imagined alternate reality.After the viral success of her Barbie-themed project, she worked on a theme called "Lilliputian Entropy," showing European-style rooms fallen into disrepair.-----Flickr SetBarbie Trashes Her Dreamhouse
